review_evidence: README describes the project as an SDL3 bindings example and real-time Doom-style raycasting engine written to learn Lean's FFI.
The four primary Lean files are Engine.lean, Main.lean, SDL.lean, and lakefile.lean; a declaration scan finds no theorem, lemma, example, or axiom declarations.
Source inspection shows executable/game/FFI implementation, not an independently addressable mathematical development or verified semantics.

source_action.content_invariant: The repository is executable SDL/game infrastructure with no formal theorem/proof development, so it falls outside COPY-005's corpus-source invariant.
